title: BuildKit cache mounts for package-manager downloads
hypothesis: When requirements.txt changes, a RUN --mount=type=cache on pip's cache directory cuts the rebuild time versus a plain RUN pip install because wheels are served from the persistent cache instead of PyPI. The gain scales with dependency download size and network latency, so it is smaller on a fast connection.
notes: Mutating requirements.txt (appending a comment) invalidates the pip layer in both variants; the cache mount persists across builds via BuildKit, independent of layer cache.
